managerRecommendations.note: Series Engine v0 keeps short-sample readiness and season-to-date League Intelligence distinct. League context can establish opponent performance evidence, but lineup, pitching, bullpen, and tactical prescriptions remain gated by probable-starter, roster/card, and bullpen-availability evidence.

managerialWatchlist.evidence: Norwich created the five-run Game 71 second after two outs; Norwich also extended the Game 72 sixth with two outs; Aquarium scored all three decisive Game 72 seventh-inning runs after two outs.
managerialWatchlist.finding: Two-out inning extension materially influenced multiple decisive innings in this series.
managerialWatchlist.title: Two-out inning extension materially influenced multiple decisive innings in this series.

eligiblePreviewSignals.evidence: Chance preserved the bullpen in Game 70; lower-leverage arms absorbed the Game 71 blowout; Knowles and Hamilton then produced three scoreless leverage innings in the 6-5 Game 72 win.
eligiblePreviewSignals.finding: Bullpen availability has series-level value. Preserving premium relievers in a noncompetitive game can directly improve the probability of converting a later close game.
eligiblePreviewSignals.futureUse: Future previews and in-series decisions should show reliever freshness and cross-game resource value, not only season ERA and static bullpen role.

eligiblePreviewSignals.evidence: The three games represented starter domination with late breakaway, a two-out collapse followed by resource preservation, and a two-out comeback followed by a bullpen lock.
eligiblePreviewSignals.finding: Final score alone is insufficient to describe how a game was decided.
eligiblePreviewSignals.futureUse: Classify completed games by shape and expose the decisive transition rather than relying on final margin.

eligiblePreviewSignals.evidence: Washburn reached two outs with nobody on in the second before the five-run rally developed rapidly.
eligiblePreviewSignals.finding: Pitcher-hook evaluation must measure when actionable deterioration became visible, not judge solely from the final pitching line.
eligiblePreviewSignals.futureUse: Evaluate hook opportunities event-by-event using score, outs, baserunners, pitcher deterioration, bullpen state, and series context.

eligiblePreviewSignals.evidence: Aquarium produced six hits and three walks in the 15-0 loss but scored zero, while Game 72 converted traffic into the decisive rally.
eligiblePreviewSignals.finding: Baserunner creation and run conversion should be measured separately.
eligiblePreviewSignals.futureUse: Separate offensive opportunity creation from sequencing/conversion when diagnosing recent performance.

eligiblePreviewSignals.evidence: Norwich outscored Aquarium 21-14 across the series, but Aquarium won two of three games.
eligiblePreviewSignals.finding: A single extreme blowout should remain visible as downside-tail evidence without dominating series-level evaluation.
eligiblePreviewSignals.futureUse: Preserve extreme losses as volatility/risk evidence while weighting individual game shape and series outcome separately.

permanentRules.evidence: Aquarium Games 70-72 resolved to Strat game IDs 417, 423, and 429.
permanentRules.finding: Team schedule game numbers must not be equated with league-scoped Strat game IDs.
permanentRules.futureUse: Always resolve game identity through /league/schedule/{leagueId}, then team schedule, then actual Strat game ID before box-score or play-by-play ingestion.

revalidationRequired.evidence: The Game 72 play-by-play explicitly recorded the injury following a hit-by-pitch.
revalidationRequired.finding: Duke Sims was injured for three additional games in Game 72.
revalidationRequired.futureUse: Retain as short-lived opponent availability intelligence only; revalidate against the live injury source before any future Norwich matchup.
